title: {{NAME}} and the Fairy Dinosaur Garden
moral: When you are kind to nature, nature is kind to you.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} walked into a big, bright garden.
The flowers were tall and pink and purple.
Tiny lights floated between the petals.
A little bunny hopped up to him.
"Hello," said the bunny. "The fairies live here."

pages.content:
{{NAME}} looked closer at a big flower.
A tiny fairy sat on a pink petal.
She had wings like a dragonfly.
"Oh!" said {{NAME}}. His eyes went very wide.
The fairy smiled and waved at him.

pages.content:
Then the ground began to shake.
Boom. Boom. Boom.
A friendly little dinosaur ran into the garden.
His green scales were bright and shiny.
He knocked over three big flowers.

pages.content:
The fairy looked very sad.
Her garden was all messy now.
"I will help fix it," said {{NAME}}.
He stood the flowers back up, one by one.
The little dinosaur helped push the soil down.

pages.content:
Soon the garden looked beautiful again.
The fairy gave {{NAME}} a tiny glowing flower.
"Thank you," she said softly.
The bunny curled up next to {{NAME}}.
{{NAME}} felt warm and happy and sleepy.
Goodnight, {{NAME}}. Tomorrow the dinosaur wants to show you something deep in the magic woods.
